text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I believe I have upgraded my physical parameters enough to handle the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: After we get back, I want to continue training just as hard as I did here, if not harder.
And with that, my final summer camp with Mihono Bourbon comes to a close.
